cases.title: UI eviction does not reopen
cases.expectation: the settled question stays ineligible with the display ring full of unrelated rows

observed.reason: already established here, and nothing about the question has changed

cases.title: evidence-cap pressure does not reopen
cases.expectation: 48 unrelated evidence rows cannot evict the durable conclusion

observed.reason: already established here, and nothing about the question has changed

cases.note: before 23D this was 18.1% of all launches, with the cap under pressure on 75.3% of band-days.

cases.title: hardship increase does not erase a confirmation
cases.expectation: the settled question stays settled across the whole hardship range

cases.title: hardship increase does not erase a bounded negative
cases.expectation: the identical search stays suppressed across the whole hardship range

cases.title: a different unresolved question remains eligible
cases.expectation: settling water access does not block resource presence at the same place

cases.title: a different target remains eligible
cases.expectation: settling one place does not suppress investigation elsewhere

cases.title: a new season permits a season-relevant retry
cases.expectation: a season the place has not been answered in reopens the question

observed.reason: a season this place has not been answered in

cases.title: repeated same season remains suppressed
cases.expectation: and once all four seasons are covered NO season reopens it — the old gate reopened 3 in 4 forever

observed.previousBehaviour: lastSeason !== currentSeason fired 3 seasons in 4 — 45.8% of all launches

cases.title: a materially different route permits reconsideration
cases.expectation: and the destination evidence itself is untouched by the route changing

cases.title: a materially different search permits a resource retry
cases.expectation: the identical search stays suppressed; a season it was never searched in reopens it
cases.note: physical signs are not represented as band state, so season and route are the changes the model can honestly detect.

cases.title: an inconclusive result retries only after material change, and is bounded
cases.expectation: too soon: no; after a real interval: yes; after three attempts: never again

observed.cappedReason: asked and left unresolved too many times

cases.title: authoritative place forgetting may reopen
cases.expectation: the question reopens ONLY when the place record itself is gone — not when a cap evicted
cases.note: this is the ONE legitimate reopening path, and it requires losing the place, not a list slot.

cases.title: a lost party transfers no disposition
cases.expectation: an unanswered target is neither confirmed nor negative and stays eligible
cases.note: the hand-off is gated on phase === 'completed', so a lost party never reaches the write seam.

cases.title: state exists only for attempted target/question pairs
cases.expectation: 15 attempts across 3 questions produce 3 entries; an unattempted place carries none

cases.title: deterministic retention
cases.expectation: identical inputs retain and order identical summaries
